review_description: They were all professional and listened to what I wanted the team were friendly and answered all questions that I asked they performed as you would expect them to
Prompt quotationSalesman explained retaining our 44 cent payment.Installers were pleasant and did a professional job.Admin team were very helpful.
The quoting process went very well with all questions explained fully. The installation was done efficiently.
Very simple process, well explained and informed. Install had no issues. They organised everything.
Our system is not yet switched on because we are waiting for Ergon to supply and fit the new meter.
After sales service nonexistent with solarhart rockhampton. I used your service to obtain my solar system and just want to give feedback
I am on a mongrel SWER system , which is a sitter for ergon to muck consumers about , so there are problems of capacity .
I am waiting to have the system installed
Need to get at least 3 quotes and discuss systems etc fully so you can make an informed choice. solar blogs info has been helpful also.

Friends of ours also had a system installed by Solartech Energy Solutions and they are extremely happy.  The quality of the panels and the inverter is  Excellent.  The reputation of this company and the quality of the components is such that we didn't bother with another quote.

Supplier took a month to install. They did not keep us informed as to what was going on. Said they would turn up but did not. When I rang up to find up what was going on (3rd time) they turned up to install without letting us know they were coming. They were lucky we were home. The installer was great.

I found the owner with whom we dealt very professional and was able to explain the system whilst answering my questions from both a layman's idea and someone who thought they knew a little as we have had a system installed at our farm for many years.It was also pleasing to note that this owner was infact an electricial engineer and following our discussions we do plan to install a battery system with additional panels once we have had sufficient time to assess the 3.6kW installed.Thanks you for your assistance and recommendations which we are happy to pass on to other people in a similar situation to ourselves.Thanks Alan

I choose Solartech Energy Solutions because the gave great service combined with great quality products with also being with a long standing name of Solahart. Nothing has been installed and therefore can't say how it works. But this is for the long term future so I think I made a good investment.

As discussed, to decide a suitable system, people need to be advised by people like yourself.  Providers will always sell their systems with the view that it is the best and value for money but to a person like myself, I would not know the difference between one system compared to another.  Most people look at the price of the systems and make a decision from there (not always the right decision)....German, Chinese etc etc???
I still do not know how to read the meter.

The best thing about Solartech was when Grant came to see me. It didn't feel like a sales pitch or being told to use my product because or don't use these guys because. He simply told me the products he uses and why and his pricing is very competitive.Had to wait a while for install but they are busy for a reason because they use quality products at the right price.Would recommend anyone in central QLD to use these guys.

Solartech Energy Solutions  provided the most informative, prompt comprehensive site inspection without sales pitch of all of the 9 installers/sellerswe contacted.  Gave us a full list of base system options from 2kW to 5kW and options regarding installation location for the panels and inverter, provided area based irradiation figures - daily and percentage against inclination, and a list of 40 biggest panel manufacturers.  They only dealt with Trina/Suntech panels and Sunnyboy/Power One inverters. Suntech was going through a restructure at the time, so Trina TSM-PC05A.08 250W panels with a 3.0kw Power One inverter for $6016 was our preferred option.  Due to competition I was able to renegotiate to $5835.  This system was installed on the 24th April 2013, 5 weeks after site inspection. We had an earlier install (3 weeks) due to other buyers not being exactly ready for an install.Installation went for about 5 hours without a fuss and looks very clean and tidy. Team of 4 were efficient,  tidy and polite. They also thanked us for the business and gave helpful advice on top of the required info regarding the operation and maintenance of the system.The other local  installer we seriously considered were Infinity Solar. Conducted site inspection that was informative and without sales pitch. Provided me with inverter and panel information and installation options.Very competitive on the quote for a 3kW system Power One 3.0 kw/ 12 Trina TSM-PC05A 250W at $6490. Due to competition for the 3kW Trina/Power One combo in QLD they did come down to $6146 and then $5835.All other quotes from other installers/sellers involved information that:was diffcult to confirm/correlate with others, orwas overpriced (one installer quoted a buget Jinko panel /Samil inverter system that was $1600 more than the Trina/PVI we obtained), orprice limited to metroploitan areas, such as Brisbane, Sydney, Melbourne, ordelivered with sales pitch, orsales service was lacking.
Solar Tech people were very efficient and kept me informed through the process
